bagPolicy.summary: At Utah Athletics events, one clear bag up to 12" x 12" x 6" (or a 1 gallon plastic bag) plus a small clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5" is allowed.
allowed: One clear bag up to 12" x 12" x 6"
One 1 gallon clear plastic storage bag
prohibited: Non clear bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
Seat cushions with pockets, zippers or compartments
bagPolicy.note: The posted policy names Utah Athletics events; confirm on your concert's event page. Diaper bags and medically necessary bags are allowed after inspection.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Lyft picks up on 500 South, just southwest of the stadium. All other rideshares pick up on 1300 East, from the S.J. Quinney College of Law to Presidents Circle.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says alcoholic beverages are available for purchase at events.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: ADA accessible gates are Gate A (suite holders only), C, E, J, and L. Gates C and E have elevators to the West Tower levels, and Gate H has an elevator to the top of the bowl. An ADA help tent on the east side of the stadium is open from gates open until two hours after the event starts.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed, and there are no hand stamps or wristbands for re-entry. For special cases, see guest services at Portals 12 and 36.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Accessible entry is at Gate A (suite holders only), Gate C, Gate E, Gate J, and Gate L. Use Gates C or E for elevators to the West Tower levels, or Gate H for an elevator to the top of the bowl.
